description:
The files table for a scope as JSON Lines (one file per line), up to 1 MiB inline. For a full SQLite
        copy with history and links, GET /index/export over HTTP.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

scope.description: Which files to cover: 'mine' (workspaces you belong to), 'store' (the store's listings, as /store shows them), 'public' (every file in public workspaces), 'all' (yours and every public one) or 'registry' (the registry itself: conventions, groups, cells, fields, aspects).
scope.title: Scope

workspace_id.description: Export one workspace only (instead of a scope).
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: export_index
